Transaction cost tracking, limit checks, and per-account cost accounting for runtime transactions.

# Purpose
This C file implements the cost tracking logic used by the runtime to evaluate transaction cost limits. It defines the `fd_cost_tracker` object, its shared-memory layout, and the functions needed to create, join, initialize, and update the tracker. The file also sets the active block, vote, and writable account cost limits from bank feature flags such as `raise_block_limits_to_100m`, `raise_block_limits_to_60m`, and `raise_account_cu_limit`.

The file also contains the cost calculation path for transactions. It computes signature cost, instruction data cost, write lock cost, and allocated account data size, then checks whether a transaction fits within the current limits before adding its cost to the tracker. To enforce per-account limits, it keeps a map of writable accounts and their accumulated cost for the current slot. The code handles simple vote transactions and non-vote transactions, and it uses system program instruction decoding to detect account allocation size from transaction data.
